# DentDock

> Dental practice management software for UK private practices: online booking, automated reminders, payments and recalls.

DentDock helps UK private dental practices run their day-to-day: patients book online, reminders go out automatically by text and email under the practice's own name, payments are taken without chasing, and recalls keep chairs full. Built for private and mixed practices (no NHS UDA management). No contracts and no setup fees. Setup can be done in a day; a full switch from another system is planned with you over a few weeks.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dentdock.co.uk/): What DentDock does, support, switching, pricing summary, FAQ and waitlist signup.
- [Features](https://dentdock.co.uk/features): Online booking, patient portal, reminders and recalls, forms, dental chart, treatment plans, payments and reports.
- [Pricing](https://dentdock.co.uk/pricing): £49 a month per practice, what's included, plans coming soon.
- [Calendar](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/calendar): Diary with a column per clinician, visit statuses, hours, leave and blocked time.
- [Online booking and portal](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/online-booking): Booking page with prices, health forms in the booking, patient portal.
- [Forms and medical history](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/forms): Form templates and builder, signatures, reminders, medical history saved to the record.
- [Dental chart](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/dental-chart): Chart existing work, findings and tooth status; BPE and BEWE; examinations with soft tissue; X-ray log with evaluations; full history of every change. Records what the clinician decides. No perio pocket chart, no imaging software link.
- [Treatment plans](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/treatment-plans): Plans and estimates from the practice's price list, options, NHS or private per line, versions, printed estimates; patients 16+ can accept private plans online (date of birth + texted code, typed name).
- [Payments and deposits](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/payments): Payment links, deposits, cancellation fees, refunds and numbered receipts via the practice's own Stripe.
- [Reports](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/reports): Money taken, no-show rates, booking sources, accountant export.
- [Security and data](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/security): storage in Europe, encryption, two-step login, team access, data export.
- [Switching to DentDock](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/switching): Guided setup and CSV patient import.
- [Reminders and recalls](https://dentdock.co.uk/features/reminders-and-recalls): Reminders 72, 24 and 2 hours before each appointment, texts sent from the practice's own name (sender ID), recall follow-ups, waitlist.
- [Reduce no-shows](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/reduce-no-shows): Evidence on reminders, fair cancellation fees, refilling gaps.
- [Fill cancelled appointments](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/fill-cancelled-appointments): Waitlist offers for cancelled slots.
- [Cut admin and phone time](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/cut-admin): Booking, forms, reminders and recalls that run themselves.
- [Deposits and late cancellations](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/deposits-and-late-cancellations): Deposits on chosen treatments and fees decided case by case.
- [Bring patients back](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/bring-patients-back): Recalls with follow-ups and Google review links.
- [Going private](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/going-private): Software for practices moving to private care.
- [New practices](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/new-practices): Set up a new practice in a day.
- [Private practices](https://dentdock.co.uk/solutions/private-practices): DentDock for UK private dental practices.
- [Guides](https://dentdock.co.uk/guides): Practical guides for UK private dental practices.
- [Missed appointment fees](https://dentdock.co.uk/guides/missed-appointment-fees): Can a private dentist charge for a missed appointment? Rules, NHS position, policy template.
- [Reminder texts and consent](https://dentdock.co.uk/guides/reminder-texts-pecr): Can a dental practice text patients without consent? Reminders, recalls and marketing under PECR and UK GDPR.
- [Free tools](https://dentdock.co.uk/tools): No-show cost and software spend calculators.
- [FAQs](https://dentdock.co.uk/faq): Pricing, switching, patients and data questions.
